claims.text: CanPay Insights (“we”, “our”, “us”) is a free Canadian take-home pay calculator, with two optional paid reports, published at canpayinsights.ca and as the CanPay Insights app for iPhone (together, the “Service”).
It sends no work pattern, stores nothing in the browser, and loads nothing from any other website.
A website that embeds it with &notelemetry=1 turns even that off: the widget then sends nothing at all.
The widget stores nothing in the browser, so it records no “before” flag;
These records contain no names, no account identifiers, no IP addresses and no device fingerprints, and are not linked back to you.

Open any page of this site with?notelemetry=1 added to the address and this browser will record nothing from then on — no calculation records and no page-view counting (?notelemetry=0 turns it back on).

The choice is stored in this browser for this site, so it does not follow you to other browsers or into our calculator where another website embeds it; a website that embeds it can switch recording off for all its visitors by adding &notelemetry=1 to the widget’s address.
Your IP address is not stored — not in these records, not in logs we keep.
Every figure we publish or license is a count for an area of thousands of households and is withheld unless at least twenty people are behind it.
4 Cookies, local storage and analytics
Cookies only if you sign in.
Signing in sets a cookie named cp_session that keeps you signed in for 30 days.
While you sign in with Google or Apple, a second cookie ( cp_oauth or cp_apple ) carries the sign-in request for up to ten minutes and is then removed.
We use no advertising or third-party tracking cookies, which is why this site has no cookie banner.

Local storage on your device holds your language choice, your calculator settings when signed out, the calculations and timesheet entries you save while signed out, the industry you last compared against, the telemetry opt-out flag, the remembered postal-code prefix and the “has calculated before” flag, plus three entries for page-view counting (below): a session number for the tab ( _av_sid ), a “visited before” flag ( _av_seen ) and an off switch ( _av_off ).
Two cookieless counters run on this site.
Neither sets a cookie or stores an IP address.
We do not use Google Analytics or any advertising network.
Our own database never receives your IP address.
The app does not yet have a switch to turn these statistics off; until it does, if you do not want them recorded, use the website with the opt-out in section 2.

Because the statistical records carry no identity, requests about them cannot be matched to a person — but the opt-out in section 2 stops any further recording from your browser, and “Change” or clearing site data removes a stored postal-code prefix.
We answer within 30 days.

Free to reuse with credit to CanPay Insights · Download SVG 4 · In which language
Working out what a job pays after tax is one of the first things anyone does on arriving in Canada, and a good deal of it is not happening in English or French.
Unlike the shift and income figures it involves no form default — a device language is a real setting either way.
It is not a measure of what anyone speaks at home or how well they read English; a bilingual person may simply prefer their own language for a page full of numbers.
Thinly-served languages will also be understated, because a language nobody knows the calculator offers is a language nobody arrives in.
Free to reuse with credit to CanPay Insights · Download SVG 5 · The weekend
Taken with the start times above, the picture is of a calculator being used mostly by people whose week is not the standard one.
The form opens on Monday to Friday with both weekend days switched off, so a weekend day is only ever present because somebody switched it on.
That makes this figure a floor and never an inflated one — the opposite of the trap in finding 2, where the default worked the other way.
Anyone who works weekends but left the days alone is counted here as not working them.
The 5,315 calculations arrived across 50 days without a gap, from August 7, 2026 onward — between a few dozen and 190 a day.

claims.text: Link to a Free Canadian Payroll Calculator

CanPay Insights is a free Canadian payroll calculator that estimates take-home pay by province, including federal tax, provincial tax, CPP, EI, hourly wage, annual salary, overtime, and timesheet tools.
claims.note: The calculator and widget have no paywall or sign-up gate; the only paid items are the two reports (check:products-two).

claims.note: The calculator has no paywall or sign-up gate; the only paid items are the two reports (check:products-two).

claims.text: CanPay Insights 是一个 免费的加拿大工资税后计算器 ，按省计算联邦税、省税、CPP/CPP2、EI （魁省为 QPP/QPP2/QPIP）后的到手工资，数据基于 2026 年 CRA 与各省最新税率。支持中文、英文、法语等十种语言，无需注册、无广告墙。
估算采用 2026 年联邦与各省税率，仅计基本个人免税额。福利、RRSP 供款、工会会费等会改变你的实际工资——用上方免费计算器算你的具体数字。
claims.note: Methodology note; the figures on /zh come from the engine (audit:numbers).

claims.text: CanPay Insights 用一个透明的规则引擎，把联邦税、省税、CPP/CPP2、EI 逐项算给你看，而不是只给一个总数。它覆盖全部 13 个省与地区、支持中英法等十种语言、完全免费且无需注册——很适合在比较 offer、规划搬去哪个省、或核对工资单时使用。
CanPay Insights 的特点：① 透明的规则引擎，逐项列出联邦税、省税、CPP/CPP2、EI；② 覆盖全部 13 个省与地区，可一键对比；③ 中文、英文、法语等十种语言；④ 完全免费、无需注册、无广告墙；⑤ 数据按 CRA 与各省 2026 年最新税率更新。

The exact money amounts you type — hourly wage, salary, tips, RRSP amounts — are never sent to us, with one exception you choose: buying a report, which is built from the salary you enter for it (section 5).
